title: The Assumption of Mary: Fourth Glorious Mystery
summary: Pray the Fourth Glorious Mystery page by page: the story of the Assumption of Mary, the Gospel, the decade prayers, and a quiet reflection.
coverAlt: Titian's painting of the Assumption: Mary is raised into the glory of heaven.

pages.title: The Assumption of Mary
pages.body: When Mary's life on earth was finished, God brought her, body and soul, into the glory of heaven. The Bible gives us a beautiful sign: a woman clothed with the sun. As we pray this decade, we ask Mary to keep our hearts pure and close to her Son.
pages.imageAlt: Titian's painting of the Assumption: Mary is raised into the glory of heaven.

evidence.claim: Original child-friendly meditation on the mystery; the mystery and its traditional day follow the standard Rosary order.

pages.title: From the Gospel
pages.body:
God's Word tells us this mystery. From the Book of Revelation, chapters 11 and 12 (Douay-Rheims Bible):

“And the temple of God was opened in heaven: and the ark of his testament was seen in his temple, … And a great sign appeared in heaven: A woman clothed with the sun, and the moon under her feet, and on her head a crown of twelve stars.”

(Revelation 11:19; 12:1)

evidence.claim: Scripture quotation reproduced word for word from the Douay-Rheims 1899 American Edition (public domain); verse numbers omitted for reading aloud and ellipses mark skipped verses.

pages.title: Praying the Decade
pages.body:
We announce the mystery: The Assumption of Mary, the Fourth Glorious Mystery. Then we pray one decade of the Rosary, holding this scene in our hearts.

Our Father, who art in heaven, hallowed be Thy name; Thy kingdom come; Thy will be done on earth as it is in heaven. Give us this day our daily bread; and forgive us our trespasses, as we forgive those who trespass against us; and lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil. Amen.

Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee. Blessed art thou among women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus. Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen. (We pray the Hail Mary ten times, once for each bead of the decade.)

Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit; as it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

O my Jesus, forgive us our sins, save us from the fires of hell; lead all souls to Heaven, especially those in most need of Thy mercy.

evidence.claim: The Our Father, Hail Mary, Glory Be and Fatima prayers use the standard formulas printed across this site.

pages.title: The Fruit of This Mystery: Devotion to Mary and purity of heart
pages.body:
This mystery grows the fruit of devotion to Mary and purity of heart. Mary is in heaven, body and soul, and she prays for us. What would you like to ask her today?

Let us pray: Mary, assumed into heaven, keep us pure of heart and close to your Son. Amen. Our Lady of the Rosary, pray for us.

evidence.claim: Original reflection and closing prayer; the fruit of the mystery follows the traditional list used across this site.
